title: WenHai-E2E: end-to-end machine learning for global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts
summary: The November 13, 2026 paper introduces WenHai-E2E, which generates global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts directly from observations and reports better forecast accuracy than a numerical system. The abstract and publication metadata reviewed here identify no separate oceanographic discovery or specific field result beyond forecast performance. Full text was not assessed.
ai_technology: WenHai-E2E (end-to-end deep learning ocean forecast model)
organization: Laoshan Laboratory; Ocean University of China; Shandong University; Qingdao Guoshi Technology Group

evidence.tested: Forecast accuracy against a numerical ocean forecasting system, without a separate discovery in the reviewed abstract.
evidence.unknown: Complete Methods and Results were not reviewed. Observation periods, evaluation timing, forecast comparisons, eddy-event interpretation and stated limitations were not assessed beyond the abstract. The reviewed material does not resolve whether the event example establishes a scientific result beyond forecast-performance validation; no absence of such a result is inferred.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning model produces the full eddy-resolving global ocean forecast from observations, replacing numerical initial conditions.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary PubMed abstract and bibliographic metadata; the PMC full-text route served browser verification. Complete primary Methods, Results and supplement were not reviewed.
